svg.title: Jet crashes on a Palm Beach County road, killing all nine aboard
svg.desc: Graphic poster illustration on a rainy afternoon: looking down a wide suburban Florida road, a burning crater in the pavement sends a black smoke column up into storm clouds, with chunks of pavement around it. Low houses, palm trees and a mobile home park stand close on either side, untouched, and two ordinary cars are stopped well back. Firefighters spray water from a red fire engine on the left; a patrol car with flashing lights and a striped barricade close the road; residents walk away under umbrellas on the right, one turning to look back. No aircraft, victims or text are shown.
